Radio World article (opened) has no dimensions, weight, fader count or connectors; it describes a low-profile table-top console with 4 stereo buses. Search summaries found no official sheet; the Wheatstone LXE manual copy returned 403. Tried: Radio World, BSW/BGS listings, manuals.online (403), Wheatstone pages (403).

portsText: S6L-24D surface (architectural spec, opened): 24 bankable touch-sensitive fader strips plus 2 user-assignable 60 mm faders, 48 user layouts; control surface (or accompanying Local 16 I/O at the mix position) provides 8 XLR mic/line inputs, 8 XLR outputs, 2 x 1/4 in TRS line outputs, 8 channels AES/EBU, USB, MIDI, GPI and footswitch connectors. Positions n/s.
notes: Row is generic ('VENUE / S6L'); values are for the S6L-24D surface from Avid's architectural spec (opened): H 91 mm front / 388 mm rear, W 989 mm, D 787 mm, 54 kg (the sheet prints 36.9 in for width, which conflicts with 989 mm = 38.9 in; the mm value is used, matching Solotech and Full Compass). Other surfaces: S6L-48D W 1934 mm 108 kg; S6L-32D-class W 1304 mm 70 kg; S6L-24C W 989 mm, H rear 205 mm 38 kg; S6L-16C W 671 mm 32 kg (the sheet's section titles were not all read, so model-to-width mapping beyond 24D/48D/16C should be re-checked). h in sizeMm is the rear (maximum) height. E6L engines (e.g. E6L-192 483 x 537 x 218.7 mm 33.5 kg) are separate.

portsText: Page (opened): PSU inlet IEC 100-240 V; PSU output Kycon KPJX-4S-S 12 V DC 3.3 A; other connectors and fader count not on the page (datasheet is behind a login). Fader module has 8 motorised touch-sensitive 100 mm faders per a search summary.
notes: Lawo technical specification (opened): modules (main and fader) 336 mm W x 286 mm D; tabletop frame without VX 352 W x 383 D x 53 H mm; with VX 352 x 493 x 216 mm; countersunk frame 352/345 x 307/293 x 14/43 mm (above/below desk), with VX 352/345 x 434/399 x 172/43 mm; weight 3.3-4.6 kg depending on frame and module. Overall console size depends on frame/module configuration, so sizeMm left null. 2023 crystal is available in several fader counts (6, 8, 14 per one source); the 2008 crystal in 4-16 faders.

portsText: Yamaha CL data sheet (opened; hosted by Rentex): local I/O 8 mic/line inputs, 8 outputs, AES/EBU output, 3 mini-YGDAI slots, GPI 5 in / 5 out, word clock I/O, MIDI I/O, network port, USB; Dante 64x64 on EtherCON (CL5 Dante model); 16 user-defined keys and 4 user-defined knobs. Fader count per Yamaha (search summary): 16 + 8 + 8 + 2 = 34 (rental sources say 32 + 2).
notes: Yamaha datasheet (opened): 1053 x 299 x 667 mm printed as W x H x D (architectural text '1053 (W) x 299 (H) x 667 (D) mm'), net weight 36 kg (79.4 lb). Yamaha US page marks the CL series discontinued.
